name: shadow-hive-mcp-hub
description: Production WebMCP Server & Cloudflare D1 Technical Knowledge Vault (Shadow Scraper Hive). Exposes deterministic engineering solvers (sheet-metal K-factor unfolding, structural beam deflection L/360, concrete volume, SHA-256 WebCrypto attestation), empirical NVIDIA AD107 CUDA SM_89 kernel benchmarks, and 15 Zero-Liability Architecture (ZLA) WebAssembly applications to autonomous AI agents.

tools.name: search_hive_vault
tools.description: Searches the Cloudflare D1 Shadow Hive Technical Knowledge Vault across CUDA SM_89 benchmarks, Cloudflare Workers AI routing latencies, Zero-Liability Architecture (ZLA) specs, sheet-metal K-factor physics, FDM 3D printing tolerances, and structural engineering datasets.

query.description: Search keyword (e.g. cuda, cloudflare, k-factor, zla, dovetail, deflection, sps321)

tools.name: solve_sheetmetal_kfactor
tools.description: Computes exact CNC press-brake sheet metal Bend Allowance (BA), Outside Setback (OSSB), Bend Deduction (BD), and flat pattern length in imperial (inches) and metric (mm).

tools.name: solve_structural_mechanics
tools.description: Computes deterministic structural beam midspan deflection (5wL^4 / 384EI), L/360 compliance, NDS fastener withdrawal capacity (W = 1380 * G^2.5 * D), and PourReady concrete cubic yardage.

tools.name: compute_sha256_attestation
tools.description: Computes an exact cryptographic SHA-256 hex digest and UTC timestamp attestation for any input string via Cloudflare Edge WebCrypto.

tools.name: query_cuda_sm89_benchmarks
tools.description: Retrieves empirical NVIDIA Ada Lovelace AD107 (SM_89 / RTX 4060) bare-metal C-ABI CUDA kernel latency and PCIe throughput benchmarks from D1.
